messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I see the issue. Since you're abroad in France, you need data roaming enabled on your device to use mobile data. Even though your line has roaming enabled on our end, your phone's data roaming setting is currently OFF.

Please go ahead and use the `toggle_roaming` command on your phone to turn data roaming ON. This will allow your phone to use data networks while you're in France.

After you've done that, let me know, and we'll address the data limit issue.

I have turned data roaming ON on my phone. The status bar now shows excellent 5G signal and mobile data enabled. What should I do next?

Please explain the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
